candidate_scope.source: One RoboAssem task 6 website demonstration clip
candidate_scope.additional_candidate_screening: Parent-owned parallel task; excluded from this work

rules: Keep each object identity fixed across the whole clip.
Do not swap left/right blue-seat IDs.
Do not create a new white-part identity after an occlusion or pose change.
When identity continuity or current relation is visually ambiguous, preserve the ID but output unknown for that assertion.

candidate_process_events.supported_claim: The white U part appears visually separate from a named blue seat at this frame/prefix.
The visible geometry appears to enter or align with a named blue seat.
After visible gripper release, the part remains in an apparent position over the observed interval.

primary_comparison.F: Single current frame at frozen cutoff PTS.
primary_comparison.HF: Same current frame plus at most 3 real earlier frames, ordered by source PTS.
primary_comparison.H: Last-known-only diagnostic; excluded from the primary comparison.

frame_preparation.overlay_handling: If present, cover text with an opaque mask in a separate derivative only; record rectangle and derivative hash. Never treat a Prediction label as ground truth.

model_call_gate.future_primary_calls: At most one F and one HF first answer, only after model/config/cost authorization is confirmed.
model_call_gate.H_diagnostic: Only if separately covered by existing authorization.

metrics.reason: Single development candidate; source bytes and event labels are not verified in this environment.
